title: Normalized threshold width
statement: Let $d$ assign a natural-number dimension to each natural number, and let $(f_k)_{k\in\mathbb N}$ be a family in which $f_k$ is a monotone, nonconstant Boolean function on the $d(k)$-dimensional cube for every $k$. For $0<\epsilon<\tfrac12$, the normalized threshold width at $k$ is the threshold width of $f_k$ divided by the bias-variance scale evaluated at its critical probability.
hypotheses_covered: For every $k$, a Boolean function on the $d(k)$-dimensional cube
caveat: The supplied definitions do not specify the critical probability or bias-variance scale.
